config.text: Yahoo Finance tools are installed. When the user asks about a stock price, ticker, index (S&P 500, NASDAQ, Dow), cryptocurrency, FX rate, market news, earnings, dividends, or historical price candles, call `yahoo_finance.quote` / `index_quote` / `crypto_quote` / `fx_quote` / `historical_candles` / `market_news` / `quote_summary` instead of guessing or quoting stale numbers from your training data. Quotes are delayed 15 minutes (standard Yahoo policy) — always show the data's timestamp so the user knows.

edges.when: let t = event.payload.text.to_lower(); t.contains("stock") || t.contains("ticker") || t.contains("price") || t.contains("market") || t.contains("shares") || t.contains("earnings") || t.contains("dividend") || t.contains("nasdaq") || t.contains("nyse") || t.contains("s&p") || t.contains("dow") || t.contains("crypto") || t.contains("bitcoin") || t.contains("ethereum") || t.contains("forex") || t.contains("exchange rate") || t.contains("portfolio") || t.contains("$")
